sourceText:
Mango and Mint Salsa
By: Kevin Tu
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 12:18am

Ingredients




1 ripe mango peeled, pitted
1/4 cup diced (¼") red onion
1 teaspoon finely-minced garlic
1/2 teaspoon finely-minced jalapeno pepper seeds removed
1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
tablespoon chopped fresh mint
tablespoon olive oil
Salt to taste
Freshly-ground black pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Cut the mango into 1/4-inch dice and place in a bowl. Add the remaining ingredients and fold together with a rubber spatula. Refrigerate, covered, for up to 3 hours before serving.

About


Comments: Begin with a ripe mango or ripen in a paper bag. First peel the skin off the mango. Slice it lengthwise on either side of the pit. This may be 4 slices. The pit may be oval. Use a serrated knife and proceed with the recipe.
